passes_since_baseline.override_reason: Not a voice patch on existing prose. Controlled single-variable ranking test: the H2 hierarchy was reordered and one new section written. A redraft from spec would move many variables at once and destroy the test.

attested.notes: Which?-register pass on the new 'What Is a CVL?' section, per humanise.md Part D. The first draft of that section failed Part D's governing rule: it opened with a clever label ('Voluntary is the word doing the work here'), presented the facts flat with no consequence attached, and set the three liquidation routes out symmetrically with no view taken. Rewritten so each paragraph is built on a practitioner observation rather than a definition: 'voluntary does not mean optional, what is voluntary is who moves first'; the concrete gain from moving first (timing, choice of IP, arriving with records in order rather than handing them to an Official Receiver you have never spoken to); the sceptical counterweight that a CVL does not buy a gentler conduct review, sourced honestly to what directors ask us on first calls; the statutory payment order 'rarely the order creditors expect'; guarantees and director loan accounts surviving the company by years, with the practitioner note that we ask about guarantees at the first conversation; and a stated view that if both routes are open there is very little to be said for waiting for the petition. Whole-page device scan run afterwards: no aphorism labels, no self-announced honesty, no em dashes, no repeated contrastive shape. Rest of the page unchanged and already carries the register.
